newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA BONDS STEADY AFTER CLOSE-OUT, RAND HOVERS.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA BONDS STEADY AFTER CLOSE-OUT, RAND HOVERS.

text.p: 1016 GMT - Bonds steady after smooth options close-out. Rand little changed in dull trade.
* Key R150 last at 14.75 pct from 14.755 pct on Wednesday and after trading in tight 14.73 to 14.77 pct range in morning session.
* Market now eyeing U.S. April non-farm payroll data at 1230 GMT for direction. Dealers say range difficult to predict, but see R150 move outside of 14.80 to 14.60 pct as unlikely.

* Rand last at 4.4505/4535 on dlr from 4.4450/4480 on Wednesday. Earlier importer demand for dollars pushes rand weaker, but London-based and local dollar supply stems further weakness. Dealers say trade exceptionally quiet and expected to remain so for rest of day. Rand seen in 4.4450 to 4.4550 range in afternoon.

* Rand doing well against sterling as cable remains under pressure in wake of Labour Party victory in British general election. Last quoted at 7.1530/1632 against sterling from around 7.21 previously.
